train_ppo_agent: train a PPO agent for navigation tasks using the PPOTrainer train method with config
setup_actor_critic_agent: setup an actor-critic policy and PPO agent from config with pretrained encoder support
eval_checkpoint: evaluate a trained PPO checkpoint on test episodes and log reward metrics to tensorboard
save_load_checkpoint: save or load a PPO trainer checkpoint with agent state dict and config
collect_rollout_step: collect a rollout step by computing actions and stepping environments for PPO training
